verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Asana's core object is 'tasks' (created via UI, API, or third-party app integrations) and community comments position it as a project/task-management tool comparable to Jira/Trello, implying basic task workflows, but no citation explicitly documents assigning tasks to teammates or setting due dates. Missing for 10: first-party docs/screenshots on task assignment fields, due-date setting, and any independent confirmation of that specific workflow.
